coder_notes: Registered as EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0/1b; translational subset). Population is WHO 2021 grade 4 glioma with glioblastoma in conditions; under CNS5 grade 4 glioma also includes IDH-mutant astrocytoma grade 4 and no IDH-wildtype requirement is stated, so coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named (gbm_only would also include). Levetiracetam is not a registered intervention but every participant must receive it as seizure prophylaxis; listed as supportive. Phase 0 is AZD1390 alone before resection; Phase 1b adds standard-of-care radiotherapy, hence regimen combination. Tumour tissue and CSF PK planned; no pharmacodynamic/target-modulation endpoint registered.
